mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tms_shipping_batch (batch_id, tenant_id, carrier_id, shipment_ids, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{batchId}, #{tenantId}, #{carrierId}, #{shipmentIds}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE tms_logistics_strategy SET strategy_name = #{strategyName}, strategy_type = #{strategyType}, origin_country = #{originCountry}, destination_country = #{destinationCountry}, preferred_carrier = #{preferredCarrier}, rules = #{rules}, enabled = #{enabled}, priority = #{priority}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND strategy_id = #{strategyId}
mapper.select: SELECT carrier_id, tenant_id, code, name, country_code, type, status, contact_person, phone, api_enabled, featured, authorization_status, authorization_valid_until, last_authorized_at, created_at, updated_at FROM tms_carrier WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY featured DESC, code ASC

SELECT rate_id, tenant_id, method_id, origin_country, destination_country, zone_code, weight_min_kg, weight_max_kg, base_cost, cost_per_kg, currency, effective_from, effective_to, created_at, updated_at FROM tms_shipping_rate WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND (origin_country IS NULL OR origin_country = #{originCountry})
AND (destination_country IS NULL OR destination_country = #{destinationCountry})
ORDER BY base_cost ASC, cost_per_kg ASC
